title: Judge step result
description: What the judge returns after reviewing an implementation (factory/prompts/judge.md). A veto sends the findings back to the implementer; a pass sends the work to human review.

verdict.description: veto when any finding is blocking, pass otherwise.

summary.description: For the human reviewer, posted on the PR: what the change does and how confident the judge is that it does what the issue asks.

detail.description: What is wrong, where, and what would fix it.

acceptance.description: One entry per acceptance criterion in the issue.
